title: Define game clock

blueprint.build: Separate game-calendar time from fight simulation time
blueprint.test: Clock tests show no unintended time advancement
blueprint.scope: Pure headless explicit clock state only; no UI, fight-clock engine or gameplay

decisions.owner_sign_off: No new UX/creative approval required for headless pure data representation; DEC-030 explicitly remains OPEN

acceptance_criteria.AC-01: PASS: immutable typed separate calendar day index and fight elapsed milliseconds
acceptance_criteria.AC-02: PASS: explicit isolated advancement and fight-only reset keep unrelated clock values and object identities unchanged
acceptance_criteria.AC-03: PASS: no implicit host time, timer, DOM, storage, RNG or UI coupling; idle/navigation cannot advance either axis
acceptance_criteria.AC-04: PASS: input guards for invalid values, rejected actions, overflow and deterministic replay
acceptance_criteria.AC-05: PASS: @ts-expect-error strict TypeScript unit mismatches and readonly fields
acceptance_criteria.AC-06: PASS: npm ci, strict typecheck, domain graph, negative fixture, lint, full Node suite, genuine Vite build, all prior regression workflows
acceptance_criteria.AC-07: PASS: 20/20 Chromium dev/preview checks at 375/390/402/430/1280 CSS pixels; no HTTP errors or JS page exceptions
acceptance_criteria.AC-08: PASS after packaging: CRC+manifest SHA-256 and exact preservation of all parent local Git object files

tests.local_environment_note: Vendored TypeScript 5.8.3 supported 15 clock tests, isolated typecheck and domain lint locally; full local project typecheck requires unavailable Preact/Pixi caches; official GitHub npm ci and full typecheck passed.

physical_iphone_safari.reason: Cannot remotely operate actual iPhone Safari; Chromium emulation does not count as device test.

exclusions: L3-119 fight clock and round logic
